notes: Time windows use a fixed demonstration observation date.
Amount is estimated from current product prices and is not historical revenue.
Gold rows are calculated against the actual database through the safe SQL tool.

cases.question: 数据库一共有多少位用户？
数据库一共有多少种商品？
数据库一共有多少笔订单？
所有订单（包含取消订单）一共购买了多少件商品？
各城市分别有多少位用户？按人数从多到少排列。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY city ORDER BY user_count DESC, city

cases.question: 各订单状态分别有多少笔订单？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC, status

cases.question: 各城市的用户分别产生了多少笔订单？包含所有订单状态，按订单数从多到少排列。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT u.city, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY order_count DESC, u.city

cases.question: 以2026-10-01为观察日，最近30天（含观察日）一共有多少笔订单？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-09-02' AND created_at < '2026-10-02'

cases.question: 以2026-10-01为观察日，最近30天（含观察日）新增了多少位用户？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= '2026-09-02' AND created_at < '2026-10-02'

cases.question: 排除取消订单，按当前商品价格估算所有订单的总金额是多少？请说明不是历史成交金额。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.price), 2) FROM orders AS o JOIN products AS p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'
cases.amount_basis: quantity * current products.price; excludes cancelled; not historical sale price

cases.question: 排除取消订单，按月份统计基于当前商品价格估算的订单金额，并按月份排列。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.created_at) AS month, ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.price), 2) AS estimated_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN products AS p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.created_at) ORDER BY month
cases.amount_basis: quantity * current products.price; excludes cancelled; not historical sale price

cases.question: 排除取消订单，销量最高的前5种商品是哪些？按购买件数排名，相同件数按商品ID排列。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(o.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders AS o JOIN products AS p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, p.id LIMIT 5

cases.question: 排除取消订单，按商品类别统计基于当前商品价格估算的订单金额，按金额从高到低排列。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.price), 2) AS estimated_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN products AS p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY estimated_amount DESC, p.category
cases.amount_basis: quantity * current products.price; excludes cancelled; not historical sale price

cases.question: 北京一共有多少位用户？
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE city = '北京'

cases.question: 排除取消订单，按当前商品价格估算，订单金额最高的商品是哪一种？请说明不是历史销售额。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.price), 2) AS estimated_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN products AS p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY estimated_amount DESC, p.id LIMIT 1
cases.amount_basis: quantity * current products.price; excludes cancelled; not historical sale price

cases.question: 排除取消订单，各类商品分别销售了多少件？按购买件数从高到低排列。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(o.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders AS o JOIN products AS p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, p.category
